BattlePointPage.Title: Battle Point
BattlePointPage.TipLead: Battle score is calculated based on the enemy's level and the damage dealt. Battle points are derived by summing the 12 battle scores and dividing the total by 10,000. This includes:
BattlePointPage.Tip1: Top 3 highest scores from different music track
BattlePointPage.Tip2: Top 3 highest scores for each attribute, excluding the above tracks.

RatingPage.Title: Rating
RatingPage.TipLead: Single track ratings are calculated from internal levels and scores. LUNATIC 0 charts and Bonus Tracks are always excluded. The player rating is the sum of three ratings, including:
RatingPage.Tip1: Average of 10 highest ratings from new version charts, divided by 5
RatingPage.Tip2: Average of 50 highest ratings from old version charts
RatingPage.Tip3: Average of 50 highest platinum star ratings of charts from all version
RatingPage.DataVersionWarning: Due to a mismatch between the game and server data versions, the internal levels or rating calculations may be incorrect.
